Package it.polimi.ingsw.controller

Class MessageBuilder

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.controller.MessageBuilder
All Implemented Interfaces:
GameObserver
public class MessageBuilder extends Object implements GameObserver
This class is the MessageBuilder class of the controller side of the application. It allows the controller to build messages to be sent to the connected players according to a specific game event.
